description: stablenet: attaches to a go-stablenet network we did not compose. The address comes only from GSTABLE_TESTNET_RPC and has no default — a default would let a forgotten variable measure the local network quietly and report it as the testnet. keysDir is left out for the same reason: node1, faucet and dev1 under presets/keys are addresses our genesis made, so on somebody else's network a label asks for the balance of an unrelated address. A label that does not resolve stops the case there, which is the better failure. provides names only what we know; we cannot tell whether the admin namespaces are open, so consensus is not claimed until it is confirmed.
